notes:
What's new in 0.1.143:
- Browser player on a phone: the More menu now has Full screen. Tapping outside the menu or pressing Back closes only the menu and keeps you in the film, and the picture fits a sideways phone.
- Browser player: if switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data reloads a film that was playing, it carries on playing. A film you paused stays paused.
- Browser player: the Back link takes you back to the Movies search you came from. On a computer, with the video selected, the left and right arrow keys jump back or forward 5 seconds.
- Browser Cast button: it no longer says that no Cast device was found before the search for devices has finished.
- Paired TVs and viewer links are for watching only. In the browser they can no longer open Admin, upload files, make API keys, open Audiobooks, use sing-along recordings, or join Watch Together, Family Watch, Phone speakers or live rooms; they are asked to sign in as a household member.
- Parental controls: bedtime and Family viewing now also apply to music, audiobooks, podcasts and radio played from a link (the browser, the car or a Cast device), checked again every 15 seconds while listening. The daily viewing limit still stops audiobooks, but music, podcasts and radio can keep playing after a child reaches it.
- Watch Together for household members: this PC now allows it by default. Members can start and join a watch party once the phone app and Beebo's online service also allow it.
- Space Saver (phone backup to this PC): a backup never replaces a file that is already in the backup folder; it is saved as a separate numbered copy. This PC reads the whole saved file back before telling the phone it may remove its own copy, also on a nearly full drive. Older phone versions that check about 400 files at once now get their answer before they give up.
- Films and TV lists: a film is hidden as a duplicate of a copy in another library, or of its converted copy, only when it really is the same file. Folders whose names differ only in capital letters stay separate on drives that treat them as different.
- Movie Night: room codes fit narrower TV screens, the score header and QR code fit an upright phone, guests using a screen reader hear when Movie Night ends, and the message shown when a preview or poll is refused is translated.
- Music: in the browser, Music windows stay above the playback controls; in this window, the Music Mix playback controls stay in view.
- Settings search says "1 matching subsection" when only one matches. The Backup restore preview headings are translated, and more Podcast and upload messages are translated into Spanish.
- Windows only. The phone app and Beebo Auto are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the full Windows desktop test suite was run on the release source (2,194 test files, 22,598 tests): 22,448 passed and 1 failed. The one failure is in the test tooling itself (its list of expected skips was updated without its sample data) and does not test the app. 111 tests in 35 files were skipped, so they were not run (mostly checks that need Linux, file links, an optional browser package or an opt-in switch), and 38 are marked as future work. The signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. No person has installed 0.1.143 yet, so its changes and its in-app update from 0.1.142 have not been tried by a person.
- Release source commit 8f992ea1e.
